subject: Biotechnology
title: How mRNA Vaccines Work
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: How mRNA Vaccines Work.

hook.text: mRNA vaccines teach your cells to make a viral protein — your immune system then learns to attack it.

buildup.text: Lipid nanoparticles deliver the mRNA into cells — the mRNA instructs ribosomes to build the spike protein.

discovery.text: The immune system sees the spike protein as foreign — B cells make antibodies, T cells learn to kill infected cells.

twist.text: mRNA degrades in days — no permanent genetic change occurs. The instructions vanish after the job is done.

climax.text: Pfizer and Moderna vaccines were designed in days and tested in months — mRNA slashed vaccine development time.

punchline.text: Send the recipe, not the virus — mRNA vaccines teach immunity from instructions.

quiz.question: Why do mRNA vaccines not alter your DNA?
options: They contain a special enzyme that protects DNA
mRNA works in the cytoplasm and degrades within days without entering the nucleus
The lipid nanoparticle prevents mRNA from reaching chromosomes
